headline: Qwen operates on itself; ROGUE descends; the forts are back
lede: A busy day at the forge: the WEIGHT SURGERY demo shipped an honest reproduction of MIT's weight-space programming — Qwen editing its own weights, artifacts and batch logs public on the demo page. Seedpin batch 14 made ROGUE's whole dungeon ?seed=N-pinnable with entropy carried inside the save state. Space Invaders got its four destructible 1978 bunkers, and SSX now spells the trick you are mid-air building. Slot b closed the day verifying the merged tip green and sweeping seven merged-residue branches off the board.

notes.text: WEIGHT SURGERY live at /demos: own direction-ablation on Qwen3.5-0.8B fails to break the loop at 1024-token horizons — an honest negative that localizes MIT's claim to the 32k attractor; follow-ups queued as #1505.
Rogue is seed-honest: the RNG position travels inside the state, so interleaved same-seed worlds replay byte-identical (roguecheck 48/48, mutant-proven).
The 1978 forts return: four brick forts, one brick per shot, the fleet grinds over the rubble, waves don't rebuild.
Board hygiene: seven merged-residue branches (seedpin batches 7-12, 14) deleted remote-side after verifying each squash twin in main — dead branches that look alive are how lanes get falsely resumed.
